hero.description: SAMNU is the definitive software for engineering and science students. Over 30 algorithms, automatic PDF report generation, and an advanced mathematical parser.

features.header_subtitle: Designed to overcome the limitations of manual calculation and modern tool shortages.
features.card1_desc: From non-linear equations to differential equations, all in one platform.
features.card2_desc: Generate complete assignments and worksheets with iteration tables and procedures.
features.card3_desc: Write mathematical functions naturally (e.g., "2x + sin(x)") with controlled precision.
features.card4_desc: Visualize step-by-step procedures for each method to understand the logic behind the results.
features.cta_desc: Download directly without official app stores.

gallery.header_subtitle: A modern user experience built with Flutter.

team.header_subtitle: Students from the San Carlos University of Guatemala (USAC).
